lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑过去，尾巴轻摆。
lines.en: I skim the sand with a lazy flick of my tail.

lines.zh: 海草缝里穿行，我熟练得很。
lines.en: Threading the seagrass gaps is second nature to me.

lines.zh: 我绕着礁石转圈，找躲身处。
lines.en: I circle the reef rock looking for somewhere to hide.

lines.zh: 水一凉，我就往浅处游。
lines.en: When the water cools, I head for the shallows.

lines.zh: 两三条同伴跟着我一起游。
lines.en: A couple of my kind trail along behind me.

lines.zh: 鲨鱼从上头掠过，我钻进草里。
lines.en: A shark sweeps over; I dive into the weeds.

lines.zh: 浅海的水暖，我游得欢。
lines.en: The warm shallows put a spring in my swim.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床，一路啄过去。
lines.en: I hug the seabed, pecking as I go.

lines.zh: 沙里冒出气泡，我绕开它。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the sand; I steer around them.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流游过整片浅滩。
lines.en: I ride the warm current across the whole flat.

lines.zh: 别踩水，我游得比你快。
lines.en: Do not wade in; I swim faster than you.

lines.zh: 我摆一下尾，钻进石缝里。
lines.en: One tail-flick and I slip into a crevice.

lines.zh: 这水温刚好，我多转两圈。
lines.en: The water is just right; I do another lap.

lines.zh: 我游过一片珊瑚，慢了下来。
lines.en: I drift past the coral and slow down.

lines.zh: 我在礁石背面绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle around the back of the reef rock.

lines.zh: 我啄开沙粒，找底下的小虫。
lines.en: I peck through the sand for tiny bugs.

lines.zh: 同伴游散了，我慢慢跟上去。
lines.en: My school has scattered. I drift back to them.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草边，往深处挪。
lines.en: I hug the seagrass edge and slide deeper.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，只看沙子动。
lines.en: I hover and watch the sand shift.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，我歇一会儿。
lines.en: My gills open and close while I rest.

lines.zh: 有只小蟹爬过，我没动。
lines.en: A little crab scuttles by; I stay still.

lines.zh: 水面的光一晃一晃，我犯困。
lines.en: Light flickers on the surface and my eyes droop.

lines.zh: 我含了口水，又吐出去。
lines.en: I take in water and spit it back out.

lines.zh: 石缝里有动静，我听着。
lines.en: Something stirs in the rocks; I listen.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，装成一片叶子。
lines.en: I tip sideways and pass for a leaf.

lines.zh: 大鱼游过，我屏住不晃。
lines.en: A big fish passes; I hold completely still.

lines.zh: 水底暖暖的，我不想动。
lines.en: The bottom is warm and I refuse to move.

lines.zh: 我数着飘过去的海草。
lines.en: I count the seagrass drifting past me.

lines.zh: 有贝壳合上，咔的一声。
lines.en: A shell snaps shut somewhere with a click.

lines.zh: 我拿嘴唇碰了碰石头。
lines.en: I bump the stone with my lips.

lines.zh: 这一刻水里静得发闷。
lines.en: The water goes quiet and heavy just now.

lines.zh: 我吐个泡，看它慢慢上浮。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it climb.

lines.zh: 你在浅水里站了半天了。
lines.en: You have been standing in the shallows half the day.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，正对着你的影子。
lines.en: I turn side-on to face your shadow.

lines.zh: 你手上的网我认得。
lines.en: I know that net in your hands.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我咬得动甲壳。
lines.en: Keep your hand back; I can bite through shell.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水里白得显眼。
lines.en: Your feet look pale and obvious down here.

lines.zh: 我看着你不动，你也僵住了。
lines.en: I hold still and watch; you freeze too.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道不像海里的。
lines.en: You do not smell like anything from the sea.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，试探。
lines.en: I circle halfway around you to test.

lines.zh: 水里倒映出你的脸，我看见了。
lines.en: Your face is mirrored on the surface; I see it.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就钻礁缝。
lines.en: Come closer and I dive into the reef gap.

lines.zh: 鳞片被刮掉了一片。
lines.en: A scale has been scraped off me.

lines.zh: 疼，我往礁石缝里钻。
lines.en: It hurts; I dive into the reef crack.

lines.zh: 谁打的我，水都浑了。
lines.en: Who hit me? The water clouded up.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，勉强稳住。
lines.en: I flip over and barely steady myself.

lines.zh: 才六点血，别真打。
lines.en: I only have six points; stop hitting.

lines.zh: 我的鳍抖得厉害。
lines.en: My fins are shaking badly now.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞到沙上。
lines.en: That blow knocks me onto the sand.

lines.zh: 我护住肚子，往深处躲。
lines.en: I guard my belly and hide deeper.

lines.zh: 我死了只会留一条金鱼。
lines.en: Kill me and you get one golden fish.

lines.zh: 再打我就要跑了。
lines.en: Hit me again and I am gone.

lines.zh: 那点碎肉落在沙上，香。
lines.en: That scrap of meat on the sand smells good.

lines.zh: 我闻到蟹肉，尾巴先动了。
lines.en: I smell crab meat and my tail moves first.

lines.zh: 你把饵放低些，我再过来。
lines.en: Lower the bait and I will come over.

lines.zh: 我绕一圈，先看看有没有钩。
lines.en: I swim a lap first, watching for the line.

lines.zh: 水里那味道勾得我发慌。
lines.en: That scent in the water makes me restless.

lines.zh: 我啄一下又退开，反复试探。
lines.en: I peck once, retreat, and try again.

lines.zh: 这块虾肉比贝壳好啃。
lines.en: This shrimp is easier to bite than shell.

lines.zh: 我不抢，等你松手再吃。
lines.en: I will not snatch it; drop it first.

lines.zh: 饵一沉底，我就冲过去。
lines.en: The moment the bait sinks, I dart in.

lines.zh: 吃完了，你还有别的吗。
lines.en: That is gone; do you have more?

lines.zh: 你脚一挪，撞得我翻个身。
lines.en: Your foot shifts and knocks me over.

lines.zh: 喂，你踩到我的水道了。
lines.en: Hey, you are standing in my path.

lines.zh: 我被挤开，鳞片擦到石头。
lines.en: I get shoved aside, scales scraping rock.

lines.zh: 别追着我游，我怕撞礁。
lines.en: Do not chase me; I will hit the reef.

lines.zh: 一碰我就窜出去老远。
lines.en: One bump and I shoot far away.

lines.zh: 你腿搅起的沙子糊住我眼。
lines.en: Your legs stir sand right into my eyes.

lines.zh: 水被你撞出一圈圈波纹。
lines.en: You push rings of ripples through the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子绕过去。
lines.en: I slip around the side of your boots.

lines.zh: 撞一下不要紧，别再来。
lines.en: One bump is fine; do not do it twice.

lines.zh: 我退开半条鱼身，让路给你。
lines.en: I back off half a length to let you pass.

lines.zh: 这个季节，水暖，正好成对。
lines.en: The water is warm this season, good for pairing.

lines.zh: 我侧着身抖鳞，给她看颜色。
lines.en: I flash my scales sideways for her to see.

lines.zh: 我和她贴着同一块石头打转。
lines.en: She and I turn around the same stone.

lines.zh: 另一条鱼靠过来，我没赶它。
lines.en: Another wrasse comes near and I let it stay.

lines.zh: 沙窝挖好了，就在石缝后。
lines.en: The sand nest is dug behind the rock.

lines.zh: 我用吻碰了碰她的侧腹。
lines.en: I nudge her flank with my snout.

lines.zh: 水草中间，我们并着游。
lines.en: Among the weeds we swim side by side.

lines.zh: 她不走，我也就不游远。
lines.en: She stays, so I do not swim far.

lines.zh: 这窝卵得看着，别让蟹来。
lines.en: These eggs need watching; crabs would love them.

lines.zh: 等水暖透了，我们再散开。
lines.en: When the water warms through, we part.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块贝壳，又吐掉。
lines.en: I pick up a shell and spit it out.

lines.zh: 你丢下来的东西，我看看。
lines.en: Let me look at what you dropped.

lines.zh: 这块亮片不是吃的吧。
lines.en: This shiny scrap is not food, is it?

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶了顶那枚石子。
lines.en: I nudge that pebble with my mouth.

lines.zh: 东西沉底了，我绕着看。
lines.en: The thing sank; I circle it and look.

lines.zh: 我咬住一角，嚼了嚼。
lines.en: I bite a corner and chew it.

lines.zh: 不是蟹肉，我就放下。
lines.en: It is not crab, so I let it drop.

lines.zh: 我把它推到石缝里藏起来。
lines.en: I shove it into a crevice to hide.

lines.zh: 你先别捡，我还要用。
lines.en: Do not grab it yet; I still want it.

lines.zh: 叼着走太累，还是算了。
lines.en: Carrying it is tiring; never mind.

lines.zh: 石缝里有蟹腿在动，看到了。
lines.en: A crab leg twitches in the crack; spotted.

lines.zh: 沙面上有条小虫在拱，我盯上它。
lines.en: A worm arches on the sand; I mark it.

lines.zh: 那只小蟹离礁石太远了。
lines.en: That little crab has strayed too far from cover.

lines.zh: 水流把气味送来，就在左边。
lines.en: The current brings the scent; it is left.

lines.zh: 我看准了，它没发现我。
lines.en: I have it lined up and it has not noticed.

lines.zh: 一只虾在石头边梳须子。
lines.en: A shrimp grooms its antennae by the rock.

lines.zh: 它翻壳的样子太慢了。
lines.en: It is far too slow flipping its shell.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着沙过去。
lines.en: I flatten low and slide along the sand.

lines.zh: 那只小蟹是我的了。
lines.en: That small crab is mine now.

lines.zh: 别惊动它，我要下手了。
lines.en: Do not startle it; I am moving in.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，等它露出背。
lines.en: I circle it, waiting for its back to show.

lines.zh: 它的钳子举起，我先退半寸。
lines.en: Its claws come up; I back off an inch.

lines.zh: 我假装游开，其实绕到后面。
lines.en: I pretend to leave, then swing behind it.

lines.zh: 它想钻石头，我堵住口。
lines.en: It wants the rock hole; I block the way.

lines.zh: 水一静，它更慌了。
lines.en: The water stills and it panics more.

lines.zh: 我盯着它那对细腿。
lines.en: I fix on those thin little legs.

lines.zh: 差半个鱼身，我就能下嘴。
lines.en: Half a length more and I can strike.

lines.zh: 它在沙上刨，扬起白雾。
lines.en: It digs the sand, kicking up white haze.

lines.zh: 它挪半步，我立刻贴上去。
lines.en: It backs off and I press forward.

lines.zh: 我等它先动，然后跟着动。
lines.en: I let it move first, then follow.

lines.zh: 一口咬住蟹壳边缘。
lines.en: I bite down on the crab's shell rim.

lines.zh: 牙一合，壳裂了一道。
lines.en: My teeth close and the shell splits.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它掀翻在沙上。
lines.en: I shake my head and flip it in the sand.

lines.zh: 这一下只值三点伤害。
lines.en: That bite only lands three points.

lines.zh: 它夹我嘴，我咬得更紧。
lines.en: It pinches my mouth; I bite harder.

lines.zh: 壳碎了，白肉露出来。
lines.en: The shell breaks and pale meat shows.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，它滑出去。
lines.en: I ram it and it slides away.

lines.zh: 别以为我小就咬不疼。
lines.en: Do not think small means my bite is soft.

lines.zh: 咬一口，我退开换口气。
lines.en: One bite, then I pull back for air.

lines.zh: 甲壳类在我这没有胜算。
lines.en: Shelled things do not stand a chance here.

lines.zh: 温带浅海里，我悄无声息地出现。
lines.en: I appear quietly in the temperate shallows.

lines.zh: 这一片浅滩，一次来一两只。
lines.en: One or two of us come to this flat.

lines.zh: 暖水刚没过海草，我就到了。
lines.en: I arrive as warm water covers the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我从礁石背阴处游出来。
lines.en: I swim out from the shaded side of the reef.

lines.zh: 沙底亮起来，是我的时辰。
lines.en: The seabed brightens; this is my hour.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋把我放到浅海里。
lines.en: A spawn egg put me in the shallows.

lines.zh: 这湾水不深，正合我意。
lines.en: This bay is shallow, just as I like.

lines.zh: 我从这片温带海开始游。
lines.en: I start swimming from this temperate sea.

lines.zh: 两只一起出现，别嫌我们小。
lines.en: Two of us show up; do not mind our size.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就有名字了。
lines.en: The water stirs and I have a name.

lines.zh: 水这么烫，我受不了。
lines.en: The water is scalding; I cannot bear it.

lines.zh: 我被摔出海面，砸在石上。
lines.en: I am thrown from the sea onto rock.

lines.zh: 我被晾在干沙上，鳃在抖。
lines.en: Left on dry sand, my gills flutter.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被冲得打旋。
lines.en: The blast rips the water and spins me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的鳍根。
lines.en: An arrow skewers the root of my fin.

lines.zh: 一股怪力抓住我的鳃。
lines.en: Some strange force grips me by the gills.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到蟹，肚子塌了。
lines.en: Three days without crab; my belly sinks.

lines.zh: 雷劈进浅海，我整条都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows; I go numb.

lines.zh: 水没了，下面全是黑的。
lines.en: The water is gone and everything below is black.
